items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: And a fellow he used to call, I can't call his name, but he used to play Madeline. His name was Allen too.

ctx.x: See, we had two Mexicans at my home. That's why Gabriel liked from those two Mexicans, you know. One was a trumpet player and one was a violin player. Oh, really? Yeah. And they were stopping at his home, you know. And a fellow he used to call, I can't call his name, but he used to play Madeline. His name was Allen too.
Allen. Yeah, Allen. These Mexicans, did they play just their own Spanish music or was it sort of like jazz too?
